annotation.justification: The clause uses the word 'SHOULD', which grants discretion to the implementer but does not introduce ambiguity in the operational meaning. The requirement is clear: endpoints are encouraged to send an ACK frame immediately upon receiving an out-of-order ack-eliciting packet to assist loss detection. There is no conflicting or missing constraint that would lead to materially different implementations.
